expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: AutoupdateConfig resource definition v1 from Teleport

maintenance_window_duration.description: maintenance_window_duration is the maintenance window duration. This can only be set if `strategy` is "time-based". Once the window is over, the group transitions to the done state. Existing agents won't be updated until the next maintenance window.

mode.description: mode specifies whether agent autoupdates are enabled, disabled, or paused.

schedules.description: schedules specifies schedules for updates of grouped agents.

canary_count.description: canary_count is the number of canary agents that will be updated before the whole group is updated. when set to 0, the group does not enter the canary phase. This number is capped to 5. This number must always be lower than the total number of agents in the group, else the rollout will be stuck.

days.description: days when the update can run. Supported values are "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun" and "*"

wait_hours.description: wait_hours after last group succeeds before this group can run. This can only be used when the strategy is "halt-on-failure". This field must be positive.

strategy.description: strategy to use for updating the agents.

mode.description: Mode defines state of the client tools auto update.
